
  Set a value for a key with an optional @ db. If VALUE is omitted, read value from the standard input.                 
         
  USAGE  
         
    skate set KEY [@DB] [VALUE] [--flags]  
            
  EXAMPLES  
            
    skate set foo bar                      
    skate set foo <./bar.txt               
         
  FLAGS  
         
    -h --help  Help for set
    --store    Path to the Skate store (defaults to SKATE_STORE or the user data directory)
